title: Move Zeroes
description:
# Move Zeroes

Given an integer array `nums`, move all `0`'s to the end of it while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements.

**Note** that you must do this in-place without making a copy of the array.

## Example 1:

**Input:** nums = [0,1,0,3,12]
**Output:** [1,3,12,0,0]

## Example 2:

**Input:** nums = [0]
**Output:** [0]

## Constraints:

*   `1 <= nums.length <= 10^4`
*   `-2^31 <= nums[i] <= 2^31 - 1`

tests.description: Mix of negative, positive and zeros

solutions.name: Two Pointers - Optimal Swap
solutions.description: Use slow pointer to track position for non-zero elements. When a non-zero is found, swap it with position at slow pointer. This maintains relative order.

solutions.name: Two Pointers - Copy then Fill
solutions.description: First pass: move all non-zero elements to the front. Second pass: fill remaining positions with zeros.

solutions.name: Two Pointers - Optimized Swap
solutions.description: Optimized version that avoids swapping when slow equals fast (no zeros encountered yet).
